module.name: Weather
module.description: Shows the weather for a place (MET Norway, no key). The server fetches the data; the player keeps the last known state offline.

refresh_min.title: Refresh (min)
refresh_min.description: Interval between two forecast updates (30 minutes minimum, as required by MET Norway terms).

contact.title: Contact (MET Norway terms)
contact.description: Email address or website appended to the identifier sent to MET Norway, which requires it to reach the operator if needed.

label.title: Place name
label.description: Displayed label (the place is not derived from the coordinates).

days.title: Number of days
days.description: Today only (1) or up to 3 days of forecast.

max_age_s.title: Maximum age (s)
max_age_s.description: Beyond this, when offline, data is considered stale and the item is skipped.

content_weather.contact_required: Contact required by MET Norway: set the contact address in the module settings.
